1. **Case #1: Negotiated sharing conversations value is 0** - The channel runs in a mode similar to WebSphere MQ V6 and does not use features such as Administrator stop-quiesce, Heartbeating, Read ahead, and Client asynchronous consume. 2. **Case #2: Negotiated sharing conversations value is 1** - The channel supports IBM WebSphere MQ V7 and later release features, but each TCP/IP channel instance has a single conversation. Set a value of 1 on the Sharing Conversations attribute and select "on" in the Share Single Conversation attribute of the mq-qm object in DataPower. 3. **Case #3: Negotiated sharing conversations value is 2 or more** - The channel supports IBM WebSphere MQ 7 and later release features, and each TCP/IP channel instance supports 2 or more conversations. Set a value of 2 or more on the Sharing Conversations attribute of the mq-qm object in DataPower and on the MQ SVRCONN channel.
